positions.commentary: Tesla's vision and mission have been successfully applied to the maritime industry, creating better, more user-friendly boats.

thesis: The episode argues that innovations from the aerospace and automotive sectors, specifically Tesla's vision and mission, are being successfully applied to the maritime industry to create better, more user-friendly boats. It notes that SpaceX, while focused on aerospace, is having its innovations considered for borrowing to maritime applications.
